body.message:
Unfortunately, we do not have any 1-bedroom apartments available within the AED 6,000 monthly budget. Our available 1-bedroom apartments are currently priced at AED 9,000 and above, depending on the location and availability.

We sincerely apologize that we are unable to offer an option within your preferred budget at the moment. If you are flexible with the location or apartment type, we would be happy to check alternative options for you.
